description: This file defines the EngineChartParser class, which provides functionality to parse a string message into an EngineChart object by unpacking key-value pairs stored in a string with delimiters.

classes.name: EngineChartParser
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parsing engine chart data from strings into EngineChart objects.

methods.name: unpackToMap
methods.description: Parses a delimited string message into an EngineChart object by mapping keys to key-value data stored in the message.
